import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int maxn = 505;
    static int n, m, mod;
    static int[][] C = new int[maxn][maxn];
    static long[] f = new long[maxn], g = new long[maxn];
    static long[][] F = new long[maxn][maxn], G = new long[maxn][maxn];

    static int add(int x, int y) {
        int res = x + y;
        return res >= mod ? res - mod : res;
    }

    static int mul(int x, int y) {
        return (int)((long) x * y % mod);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        mod = sc.nextInt();

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = add(C[i - 1][j - 1], C[i - 1][j]);
            }
        }

        f[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= i; j++) {
                int term1 = mul(mul((int)f[j - 1], (int)f[i - j]), mul(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                f[i] = add((int)f[i], term1);
                int term2 = mul(mul((int)f[j - 1], (int)g[i - j]), mul(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                g[i] = add((int)g[i], term2);
                int term3 = mul(mul((int)g[j - 1], (int)f[i - j]), mul(i + 1, C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                g[i] = add((int)g[i], term3);
                int term4 = mul(mul((int)f[j - 1], (int)f[i - j]), mul(add(C[j][2], C[i - j + 1][2]), C[i - 1][j - 1]));
                g[i] = add((int)g[i], term4);
            }
        }

        F[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= Math.min(i, m); j++) {
                for (int l = 0; l < j; l++) {
                    int temp1 = mul(mul((int)f[l], (int)F[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]);
                    F[i][j] = add((int)F[i][j], temp1);
                    int temp2 = mul(mul((int)g[l], (int)F[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]);
                    G[i][j] = add((int)G[i][j], temp2);
                    int temp3 = mul(mul((int)f[l], (int)G[i - l - 1][j - l]), C[j][l]);
                    G[i][j] = add((int)G[i][j], temp3);
                }
                F[i][j] = add((int)F[i][j], (int)f[j]);
                G[i][j] = add((int)G[i][j], (int)g[j]);
            }
        }

        System.out.println(G[n][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
